scripts.seed:check:authdb: docker compose exec -T db-auth pg_isready -U admin -d auth_db
scripts.seed:check:userdb: docker compose exec -T db-user pg_isready -U admin -d user_db
scripts.seed:check:postdb: docker compose exec -T db-post mongosh --quiet --eval "db.adminCommand({ ping: 1 })"
scripts.seed:check:mediadb: docker compose exec -T db-media mongosh --quiet --eval "db.adminCommand({ ping: 1 })"
scripts.seed:check:messagedb: docker compose exec -T db-message mongosh --quiet --eval "db.adminCommand({ ping: 1 })"
scripts.seed:auth: npm run seed:check:authdb && docker compose exec -T service-auth sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test node seed.js"
scripts.seed:user: npm run seed:check:userdb && docker compose exec -T service-user sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test node seed.js"
scripts.seed:media: npm run seed:check:mediadb && docker compose exec -T service-media sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test node seed.js"
scripts.seed:post: npm run seed:check:postdb && docker compose exec -T service-post sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test node seed.js"
scripts.seed:message: npm run seed:check:messagedb && docker compose exec -T service-message sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test node seed.js"
scripts.seed:all: npm run seed:auth && npm run seed:user && npm run seed:media && npm run seed:post && npm run seed:message
scripts.seed:auth:reset: npm run seed:check:authdb && docker compose exec -T service-auth sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test RESET_SEED=true node seed.js"
scripts.seed:user:reset: npm run seed:check:userdb && docker compose exec -T service-user sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test RESET_SEED=true node seed.js"
scripts.seed:media:reset: npm run seed:check:mediadb && docker compose exec -T service-media sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test RESET_SEED=true node seed.js"
scripts.seed:post:reset: npm run seed:check:postdb && docker compose exec -T service-post sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test RESET_SEED=true node seed.js"
scripts.seed:message:reset: npm run seed:check:messagedb && docker compose exec -T service-message sh -c "SEED_DATASET=test RESET_SEED=true node seed.js"
scripts.seed:all:reset: npm run seed:auth:reset && npm run seed:user:reset && npm run seed:media:reset && npm run seed:post:reset && npm run seed:message:reset
scripts.seed:prod: npm run seed:check:authdb && docker compose exec -T service-auth sh -c "node seed.js"
scripts.seed:prod:reset: npm run seed:check:authdb && docker compose exec -T service-auth sh -c "RESET_SEED=true node seed.js"
